data.summary:
I changed the `/api/cart` handler in `server.js` to check `lookup(data.slug)` instead of `PRODUCTS[data.slug]`. `lookup` already knows the `lamp` item code, so adding the Desk Lamp no longer returns the 500 "unknown sku lamp" error. I also made the page's add-to-cart failure handler restore the "Add to cart" button and show a clear error message, so the button no longer stays stuck on "Adding...". I haven't run the server or re-run the shopper's checks.

I left the free-shipping mismatch alone: the banner says $50 but the code only gives free shipping over $75. It wasn't one of the failed checks.

data.summary: I changed the free-shipping threshold in `server.js` from a hard-coded 7500 cents ($75) to `FREE_SHIPPING_BANNER_DOLLARS * 100` (5000 cents, or $50). The banner and the shipping check now use the same value, so a $55.00 cart ships free. I haven't run the server or the shopper's checks to confirm.
